platforms.name: Facebook
platforms.seoDescription: ReelFetch looks up Facebook videos through the official Graph API when a server access token is configured. Share links without a numeric video id are not resolved.

faqs.question: Can ReelFetch download Facebook videos right now?
faqs.answer: Only when the server has a Facebook user or Page access token that is allowed to read the video. The official Graph API source field is the file address. Without a token, lookup returns PROVIDER_NOT_CONFIGURED and nothing is downloaded.

faqs.question: Which Facebook URL formats are recognized?
faqs.answer: Numeric watch, reel, and videos links can be sent to the Graph API. facebook.com/share and fb.watch short links do not contain a video id. ReelFetch does not open those pages to extract one.

platforms.name: YouTube
platforms.seoDescription: YouTube URL formats are listed in the ReelFetch platform registry. Look up and download public YouTube videos.

faqs.question: Does ReelFetch process YouTube links?
faqs.answer: Yes. ReelFetch checks YouTube video links and prepares available quality options for download.

faqs.question: Will every YouTube link be downloadable?
faqs.answer: Public videos are supported. Private or geographically restricted videos cannot be downloaded.

platforms.name: TikTok
platforms.seoDescription: TikTok URL formats are listed in the ReelFetch platform registry. Look up and download public TikTok videos.

faqs.question: Can I download a TikTok video with ReelFetch?
faqs.answer: Yes. ReelFetch checks public TikTok video links and prepares download options.

faqs.question: Does URL recognition confirm that a video is available?
faqs.answer: URL recognition identifies the format, and lookup checks if the public video source is available.

platforms.name: Instagram
platforms.seoDescription: Instagram URL formats are listed in the ReelFetch platform registry. Look up and download public Instagram Reels and videos.

faqs.question: Does ReelFetch retrieve Instagram videos?
faqs.answer: Yes. ReelFetch checks public Instagram Reels and videos for download.

faqs.question: Can all Instagram videos be saved?
faqs.answer: Public Reels and videos can be saved. Private accounts or restricted posts cannot be accessed.

platforms.name: X
platforms.seoDescription: X URL formats are listed in the ReelFetch platform registry. Look up and download public videos from X (formerly Twitter).

faqs.question: Does ReelFetch process links from X?
faqs.answer: Yes. ReelFetch checks public X/Twitter video links and prepares download options.

faqs.question: What does a recognized X URL mean?
faqs.answer: The URL is recognized and checked for downloadable video media.

platforms.name: Pinterest
platforms.seoDescription: Pinterest URL formats are listed in the ReelFetch platform registry. Look up and download public Pinterest video pins.

faqs.question: Can ReelFetch download Pinterest videos?
faqs.answer: Yes. Public Pinterest video pins are checked and made available for download.

faqs.question: Does a Pinterest link guarantee a downloadable source?
faqs.answer: Only pins that contain video media can be downloaded.

platforms.name: Reddit
platforms.seoDescription: Reddit URL formats are listed in the ReelFetch platform registry. Look up and download public Reddit videos.

faqs.question: Does ReelFetch retrieve Reddit video sources?
faqs.answer: Yes. ReelFetch checks public Reddit video posts and merges audio and video streams for download.

faqs.question: What does recognizing a Reddit link do?
faqs.answer: It checks the post for embedded video content and prepares the file.
